# gitmoap_template (Data Source)

Get a file template. One template with its content. A field the content asks for is written `{{name}}` where its value goes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_template" "example" {
  template_key  = "mit"
  template_kind = "license"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `template_key` (String) The template's key within its kind, e.g. `mit`
- `template_kind` (String) The kind of template

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The file's text, each field written as `{{name}}` where its value goes.
- `default_path` (String)
- `fields` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `key` (String)
- `kind` (String) What a template is for.
- `name` (String)
- `spdx_id` (String)
- `summary` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) What to call it next to the input that fills it in.
- `name` (String) The placeholder's name — `year` stands for `{{year}}`.
